name: ShuratCode-skills
description: Shaked Eyal's personal skills for Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Cowork).

plugins.name: fresh-review
plugins.description: Fresh-eyes code review with enforced producer/reviewer context separation, a shared diff packet, background cross-model Codex, and per-run logging — plus a PR mode that explains the change in plain English in the repo's DDD vocabulary.

plugins.name: upgrade-all
plugins.description: One-shot local maintenance: Homebrew, gstack, and Claude Code plugin updates.

plugins.name: pull-all
plugins.description: Recursively fast-forward the main branch of every git repo under a path.

plugins.name: restaurant-search
plugins.description: Find restaurants that are verifiably open and verifiably serve a qualifying dish.

plugins.name: vault-tools
plugins.description: Ingest, query, lint, book-digest, book-note, and podcast operations for an LLM-maintained Obsidian second-brain vault, each deferring to the vault's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: everything
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs every ShuratCode skill and its dependencies.
